hooks.command: [ -d "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/aidlc/spaces" ] || exit 0; command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { if ls "${APPROVAL_GATES_DIR:-$HOME/.claude/approval-gates}"/*.json >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'Refused by the approval-gates plugin: python3 is not installed, so an open approval gate cannot be checked. Install Python 3 or disable the plugin.' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0; }; python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/gate_guard.py"
